description: Make a new live multiple-choice quiz on Polemia about any topic, ready to play on phones with a join code. Use it when the user wants a quiz, trivia game or icebreaker for a class, party, family, team or pub quiz. Takes 10 to 60 seconds. Returns join_url and code (for the players), host_url (for the person running the game: opening it makes that browser the host, and it works once), qr_url (a QR code image of the join link) and how_it_works, a short explanation of the game. Always give the user both host_url and join_url. "facts" quizzes have right answers; "opinions" quizzes are scored by what the majority picks. Topics that target people, politics, war or adult material are refused.

for_children_under.description: Make every question suitable for children under this age.

kind.description: "facts": questions with a right answer. "opinions": fun questions where the most popular answer scores.

language.description: Write the quiz in this language (BCP-47, e.g. "es", "de", "pt-BR"). Leave out to use the language the topic is written in.

topic.description: What the quiz is about, e.g. "volcanoes", "Harry Potter", "the human body for 9 year olds".

name: create_quiz

code.description: The join code players type at polemia.ai.

title: Make a Polemia quiz
